Project Information

Objective

Develop a machine-learning-based retail sales forecasting system capable of analyzing historical sales patterns and generating future sales forecasts.

Models Used

  • Random Forest
  • Gradient Boosting
  • XGBoost

The final model is selected based on forecasting performance using MAE and RMSE.
